name: Zyra
notes: Opens with Stranglethorns (R) at t=0; its 0.25s cast time keeps Zyra busy and its damage lands when that cast completes, the way the reference driver handles a delayed ultimate.

Deadly Spines (Q) and Grasping Roots (E) are then cast on cooldown for the rest of the fight, each with its own 0.25s cast time (no other cast or attack starts inside it), with basic attacks filling every gap between casts.

Grasping Roots' own wiki note says its effect lands 'at cast time end', so its damage is modeled as landing 0.25s after the press (its cooldown starts at the press, matching how League cooldowns normally work).

Deadly Spines' wiki text quotes a flat 0.625-second delay before the spines (and their damage) appear; this is taken as the full delay from the press to the damage landing rather than stacked on top of the 0.25s cast time, since the sources do not say which. The 0.25s cast time still keeps Zyra from starting another cast or attack until it ends, well before the 0.625s damage event fires.

Garden of Thorns (P), Rampant Growth (W) and the Thorn Spitter/Vine Lasher pets that Q/E can spawn by hitting a Seed are not modeled: the single-dummy fight has no other unit for a Seed to be planted near or destroyed by, and neither the dossier nor the numbers sheet gives a pet attack speed or per-hit damage to simulate their independent attacks.
Stranglethorns is only cast once at the opening: even fully hasted, its cooldown (110/100/90s base) far outlasts any fight length modeled here, so it never comes off cooldown again.

Mana costs are not modeled: the numbers sheet has no base mana or regeneration for Zyra to check against, and by the convention used for every other champion here they are assumed not to bind a level-16, <=15s fight.
